mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.lot_id AS lotId, lot.type AS balanceType, f.business_type AS businessType, f.direction, f.amount_fen AS amountFen, f.booking_id AS bookingId, f.recharge_id AS rechargeId, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM s_member_balance_flow f JOIN s_member_balance_lot lot ON lot.id = f.lot_id WHERE f.venue_customer_id = #{venueCustomerId} ORDER BY f.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_member_balance_flow f JOIN s_member_balance_lot lot ON lot.id = f.lot_id WHERE lot.source_recharge_id = #{rechargeId} AND f.business_type = 'CONSUME'
